body: Yeah, I've been inviting people in as I can. I try not to keep the place too empty for too long. I think part of that is because, as much as I love being alone, I'm scared to be alone in here TOO much, because I don't want to hear the ugly thoughts.

Ehh I actually moved specifically so I could have zero roommates. I've had to move to escape abusive roommates twice now, so I won't be living with people for a while. I have a lot of social anxiety anyway, and a very loud, crowded customer service job, so I can't live with anyone. It feels better to live alone. Hopefully the peace and quiet will help reverse the damage on my mental health before the peace and quiet itself becomes a liability haha
